t: 中国将领克辛加在9个月后攻克了台湾岛.
te: The Chinese general Koxinga seizes the island of Taiwan after a nine-month siege.
dz: 中国将领克辛加在9个月后攻克了台湾岛.
de: The Chinese general Koxinga seizes the island of Taiwan after a nine-month siege.

t: 后来成为Punch先生的人物使他首次在英国有记录地出道.
te: The figure who later became Mr. Punch makes his first recorded appearance in England.
dz: 后来成为Punch先生的人物使他首次在英国有记录地出道.
de: The figure who later became Mr. Punch makes his first recorded appearance in England.

te: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer is legally enforced as the liturgy of the Church of England, precipitating the Great Eje…
dz: 1662 年的《公祷书》作为英国国教会的礼拜仪式在法律上强制执行，导致持不同政见的牧师被逐出圣职。
de: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer is legally enforced as the liturgy of the Church of England, precipitating the Great Ejection of Dissenter ministers from their benefices.

t: 英国查理二世以 40,000 英镑的价格将敦刻尔克卖给法国路易十四。
te: Charles II of England sells Dunkirk to Louis XIV of France for 40,000 pounds.
dz: 英国查理二世以 40,000 英镑的价格将敦刻尔克卖给法国路易十四。
de: Charles II of England sells Dunkirk to Louis XIV of France for 40,000 pounds.

dz: 英国皇家海军准将克里斯托弗·明斯 (Christopher Myngs) 领导的英国海盗部队对古巴圣地亚哥发动攻击，随后被解散。
de: An English Buccaneer force led by Royal Navy commodore Christopher Myngs launches an attack on Santiago de Cuba which is subsequently sacked.

dz: 迪亚里斯特·约翰·伊夫林(Diarist John Evelyn)记录了在伦敦圣詹姆斯公园的冰冻湖上花样滑冰,由查理二世和凯瑟琳女王观看.
de: Diarist John Evelyn records skating on the frozen lake in St James's Park, London, watched by Charles II and Queen Catherine.
